semanticJob: explain a linear pipeline (frame number -> function -> values -> scene -> screenshot -> ffmpeg -> video) where every stage shows live, correct values, plus two consequences (parallel, no-render check)

candidates.why: Closest to 'persistent objects + camera + focus'. But nodes are fixed 160px label cards with no content slot, so values/ball/thumbnails cannot live inside them. Also: card entrance delay is computed from the active beat's local frame, so every card fades out and re-enters at every beat boundary (verified at frame 204 of the 18.5s demo) - this breaks its own persistence promise. Borrowed only the idea of interpolating camera from previous beat to current beat.
